info.title: FieldPilot API
info.description: Offline-first field operations API for organizations, projects, work orders, inspections, media, sync, defects, assets, reports, notifications, and operations telemetry.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Email identity, CSRF, and cookie session lifecycle.

tags.name: organizations
tags.description: Tenant, membership, invitation, and team setup.

tags.name: projects
tags.description: Project records and optimistic status changes.

tags.name: devices
tags.description: Offline device enrollment, heartbeat, package renewal, and purge.

tags.name: sites and locations
tags.description: Sites, hierarchy, GPS points, and viewport queries.

tags.name: work orders
tags.description: Work creation, assignment, scheduling, dependencies, and state transitions.

tags.name: sync
tags.description: Offline package bootstrap, push/pull, and conflict resolution.

tags.name: forms
tags.description: Form templates, immutable versions, publication, and comparison.

tags.name: inspections
tags.description: Inspection creation, drafts, submissions, and reviews.

tags.name: media
tags.description: Private resumable uploads, derivatives, malware scanning, and signed URLs.

tags.name: defects
tags.description: Defect lifecycle, assignments, corrections, and verification.

tags.name: assets
tags.description: Asset registry, QR lookup, history, and meter readings.

tags.name: daily reports
tags.description: Daily report drafts, review, signatures, publication, and export.

tags.name: metrics
tags.description: Prometheus scraping and bounded client-failure telemetry.
